mapper.select: select CONFIG_ID configId, YES_OR_NO yesOrNo, LAST_PERIOD_PRI lastPeriodPri, SEC_GRADE_PRI secGradePri from ETR_SEC_PRIORITY where rownum=1
select CONFIG_ID configId, WINDTYPEONE windtypeone, WINDTYPETWO windtypetwo, PLEDGE_PRI pledgePri from ETR_SEC_PRIORITY_DETAIL where CONFIG_ID = #{configId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select count(sys_user.user_name) from sys_user left join sys_user_role on sys_user.user_name = sys_user_role.user_id left join sys_role on sys_user_role.role_id = sys_role.role_id where 1=1 and sys_user.user_name = #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and ( sys_user.admin_flag ='01' /*管理员 */ or sys_role.role_pos = #{role_pos,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
